text.tspan: Nothing was reserved — no release needed
No order row, no order event, no email
No order row, no email — customer fixes card
the reserve happens first and is released here.
Scenario B3b — authorize call fails mid-request (timeout / 5xx)
If the authorize landed behind the timeout, the orphan hold
is recovered by the US-20 expiry sweep (built).
Scenario B4 — persisting the order fails after a 200 authorize
Scenario C — authorization expires before dispatch (US-20, built)
No expiry-specific consumers: inventory and fulfilment react to
the shared OrderCancelled event, not to PaymentAuthorizationExpired.
order-service does not publish a dispatch-failed order event.
Scenario E — capture fails after dispatch
Scenario F — customer cancels an authorized order
US-9 shared compensation — same fan-out as expiry, only the reason differs.
